purpose: Reusable art-direction brief for creating new 2D chat-room backgrounds that fit the existing room illustration.

reference.description: Top-down illustrated living room with warm plank flooring, leafy plants, a green sofa and rug in the upper-right, and a small chair with a round rug in the lower-left.

style.medium: Polished 2D digital illustration for a friendly virtual chat room
style.view: Straight-down bird's-eye view; furniture tops and floor are visible, with no horizon or isometric side walls
style.outlines: Distinct dark brown hand-inked outlines, clean and slightly organic rather than geometric or photorealistic
style.shading: Soft painted highlights and compact contact shadows under furniture; gentle cel-shading with readable forms
style.texture: Visible fine brush texture and material detail, especially wood grain, woven fibers, fabric seams, and plant leaves
style.finish: Warm, inviting, game-ready illustration with consistent line weight and moderate detail

palette.contrast: Dark outlines and shadows clearly separate props from the floor; keep the central floor area bright and readable

composition.layout: Room fills the whole canvas edge to edge. Place furniture and decoration around the perimeter, leaving a large, uncluttered central area for avatars to stand and move.
composition.playableSpace: Keep the center and likely avatar paths visually calm, unobstructed, and at a similar brightness to the reference floor.
composition.edgeTreatment: Objects may be partially cropped by the canvas edges to make the room feel continuous; avoid a visible frame or border.
composition.depthCues: Use subtle cast/contact shadows to show that sofas, chairs, tables, rugs, plants, and props rest on the floor. Do not make the floor look like a wall.

generation.promptTemplate: Create a new top-down 2D chat-room background in the same visual style as the supplied reference. Room concept: {{roomConcept}}. Use a warm, hand-painted game illustration with dark brown ink outlines, softly shaded forms, visible material texture, and cozy amber lighting. Fill the full canvas with the room floor. Arrange room-specific furniture and decoration around the perimeter and preserve a wide, uncluttered central play area for small avatars. Match the reference's outline weight, texture density, overhead camera, and friendly polished finish. Aspect ratio 3:2.

consistencyChecks: The view is directly overhead and the room has no horizon.
The illustration uses the same warm hand-drawn outline and painted-texture language as the reference.
Furniture reads clearly at chat-canvas scale and has visible contact shadows.
The center remains open enough for multiple avatars to stand without covering key props.
There are no people, text, interface elements, logos, or grid overlays.
